pose: 半身微侧，肩旁小幅竖拇指
art_direction: 虎杖以自然拇指手势与轻快笑容入画，薄荷图形背景和淡月轮形成活泼半身像。
composition: centered original head-and-shoulders anime avatar; readable iris motifs; circular-crop safe
creative_direction: Create a compact half-length Yuji Itadori portrait in a plain warm-gray sweatshirt, with his pink hair and youthful face immediately recognizable. He gives a modest thumbs-up beside one shoulder, keeping the hand small and below eye level. His grin is warm but not exaggerated, and his torso turns slightly toward the raised hand. Use graphic color blocks in mint, peach, and slate, with a few firm shadow planes that describe the cheek and sleeve. Keep the central face large enough to read at avatar size. Avoid a full environment, lettering on the sweatshirt, or extra decorative props. Use gentle rose-violet concentric iris rings around clear dark pupils, with bright catchlights. A pale moon disc sits behind the portrait as a quiet background shape, suggesting Infinite Tsukuyomi without changing the expression. Original nonviolent fan-art portrait, square 1024x1024, centered for a circular avatar crop. No text, watermark, weapons, distress, or copied scene.
style_inspiration: New text-only fan-art composition; no existing frame, panel, promotional artwork or image pixels copied.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for recognizable character, readable requested eye motif, appealing expression, original nonviolent composition, coherent anatomy, no text or watermark
